final: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination GROUP BY ID HAVING COUNT(ANA) > 0), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_ana FROM per_id) SELECT per_id.ID, per_id.avg_ana, per_id.avg_ana - overall.mean_ana AS gap FROM per_id CROSS JOIN overall WHERE per_id.avg_ana > overall.mean_ana ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
